day13_day14_evidence_starvation_diagnosi.found_while: Investigating why Day 13's conditional-hypothesis registry (15,360+ preregistered hypotheses across the 40-provider shadow-discovery population) is still nearly untested, in response to the owner wanting AIDY to actually get smarter.
day13_day14_evidence_starvation_diagnosi.real_finding_not_a_wiring_bug: provider_day13_runtime and provider_day14_governance DO run on every single deploy (scripts/render-start.sh backgrounds them before uvicorn starts) -- this was verified directly against production: provider_conditional_runs has a new row at every one of today's ~8 deploy timestamps. The actual bottleneck is upstream: of ~734 shadow-provider candidate signals eligible for AIDY context attachment, 702 got a permanent pit_context_stale terminal miss (by design, never retried -- 'a proven historical miss cannot become PIT-valid later without rewriting history') and only 82 got a real attachment.
day13_day14_evidence_starvation_diagnosi.root_cause: pit_context_stale is AIDY's own server (HTTP 409) declaring it has no valid point-in-time market snapshot for that exact historical minute -- not a Super Signals-side transport flake (the earlier-this-session M1 bounded-retry/backoff patch does not touch this 409 path, which was never retryable by design). The 702 stale misses all predate 2026-09-16T22:46Z; zero new stale misses have occurred since, and attachments have flowed normally since then (82 total, latest one 2026-09-17T09:16Z) -- this lines up exactly with AIDY's own snapshot-cadence recovery already recorded in continuous_health_verification below (53/53 complete D1 snapshots from 00:02Z onward). The historical damage is real and permanent by the system's own PIT-safety design; going forward it is healthy and self-healing.
day13_day14_evidence_starvation_diagnosi.conclusion: Day 13/14 are correctly reporting WAITING-FOR-FORWARD-EVIDENCE, not broken. Given how fine-grained the preregistered cells are (side x session x regime_dimension x regime_value x duration_bucket -- 384 cells per provider, each needing 30+ forward observations on both sides of the cell), meaningful statistical results here are a multi-month proposition even with AIDY now healthy, not a code fix. Not touched this session -- MINIMUM_OOS_N/PROPOSED_FDR_Q/PROPOSED_MIN_EFFECT_R are explicitly PROPOSED_UNAPPROVED and changing them is a real statistical-methodology call for the owner, not a routine engineering one. Built aidy_reasoning_engine_v1 (above) instead as the more direct lever for 'making AIDY smart' in the near term.

aidy_reasoning_day_map_v4.why_built: Owner: 'He should use that and map the trading day out for gold in real time, then he can refer to it throughout the day.' The get_economic_calendar tool above only fires if the model happens to decide to call it per signal -- inconsistent (no guarantee any given signal gets calendar awareness) and wasteful (repeated fetches for the same day across many signals). This is different in kind, not degree: a standing rundown of the current UTC day's own scheduled medium/high-impact events, computed fresh and folded into every signal's market_context automatically, never gated behind the model choosing to ask for it.
aidy_reasoning_day_map_v4.what_changed: fetch_todays_scheduled_events(client, as_of) (aidy_reasoning_calendar_tools.py) filters the same 3-week feed used by the on-demand tool down to just as_of's own UTC calendar day, medium/high impact only, each event labelled with session_bucket() -- the exact same asia/london/london_new_york_overlap/new_york/rollover boundaries already used everywhere else in this codebase for Gold session segmentation, reused rather than redefined. Same freshness discipline as the on-demand tool: refuses (returns None, field omitted from market_context) for a signal too old for the feed's current-week coverage rather than risk the wrong day's events. aidy_reasoning_runner.py's _fetch_market_context now combines two independently-optional sources -- regime/session context (PR 199) and the day map -- so a failure in one (e.g. AidyContextTerminalMiss) never suppresses the other. A genuinely empty day (checked, nothing scheduled) is reported honestly as an empty list, distinct from the None used when nothing could be fetched at all -- the model can tell the two apart.
